highlights: Incremental Upgrade Engine: .agents/framework-manifest.json tracks managed file hashes, skips unchanged files, preserves local edits in .agents/upgrade-patches/, and safely prunes stale framework files.
Dynamic Release Resolution (`cortex upgrade` / `npm run upgrade:skills`): Resolves the latest GitHub release tag without hardcoding old version pins, with --check, --to <tag>, and --dry-run.

Customizable Config Drift Detection: Detects missing features in playwright.config.ts (blob reporter, PW_PAUSE_FOR_EXPLORE) and .github/workflows/playwright-ci.yml (merge-reports, --only-changed) into .agents/upgrade-patches/.
Lossless Skill Overrides: Preserves .agents/skills/*/references/local-overrides.md across sync and enforces reference indexing in audit:solid.
Complex UI & Pause-Anywhere Exploration: Adds src/shared/ui/overlay-handler.ts, test:explore (PW_PAUSE_FOR_EXPLORE=1), and human-driven codegen + playwright-cli attach workflows.
Enterprise Scale Pack: Adds --summary/--squad filtering in coverage:gaps and audit:solid, PR --only-changed CI mode, and blob merge-reports.
nextActions: Run `npm run coverage:gaps` (or `/00-master-orchestrator`) to review any pending `.agents/upgrade-patches/` opt-in config updates.
Use `npm run test:explore` + `playwright-cli attach` to resume live exploration from any existing `.spec.ts`.
Place team-specific skill customizations in `.agents/skills/<skill>/references/local-overrides.md` so future syncs preserve them.
